schema.text: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while cycling (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?
schema.help: A junction with poor visibility is one where buildings, walls or parked vehicles hide traffic coming from the side.

options.text: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
Moderately confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
Quite confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
Very confident — I feel well prepared for all typical cycling hazards

en.#How confident are you in your ability t: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while cycling (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?
en.#A junction with poor visibility is one: A junction with poor visibility is one where buildings, walls or parked vehicles hide traffic coming from the side.
en.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
en.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
en.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderately confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
en.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Quite confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
en.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Very confident — I feel well prepared for all typical cycling hazards

it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti capace di prevedere e affrontare situazioni pericolose mentre pedali, ad esempio portiere di auto che si aprono improvvisamente, veicoli che tagliano la strada o incroci con scarsa visibilità?
it.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Un incrocio con scarsa visibilità è un incrocio dove edifici, muri o veicoli parcheggiati nascondono il traffico che arriva di lato.
it.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Per niente capace — mi sento impreparato/a ad affrontare queste situazioni
it.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Poco capace — sono consapevole dei rischi, ma spesso vengo colto/a di sorpresa
it.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderatamente capace — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni, ma alcune mi preoccupano ancora
it.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Abbastanza capace — prevedo la maggior parte dei pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Molto capace — mi sento ben preparato/a ad affrontare i pericoli tipici di chi va in bicicletta

fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’anticiper et de réagir aux situations dangereuses à vélo, par exemple une portière qui s’ouvre soudainement, un véhicule qui coupe votre trajectoire ou un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité ?
fr.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité est un carrefour où des bâtiments, des murs ou des véhicules garés cachent la circulation venant du côté.
fr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Pas du tout en confiance — je ne me sens pas préparé(e) à ces situations
fr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Un peu en confiance — je connais les risques, mais je suis souvent surpris(e)
fr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Modérément en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations, mais certaines m’inquiètent encore
fr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Plutôt en confiance — j’anticipe la plupart des dangers et je réagis correctement
fr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Très en confiance — je me sens bien préparé(e) aux dangers habituels à vélo

de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, gefährliche Situationen beim Radfahren früh zu erkennen und darauf zu reagieren, zum Beispiel plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren, abbiegende Fahrzeuge oder unübersichtliche Kreuzungen?
de.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Eine unübersichtliche Kreuzung ist eine Kreuzung, an der Gebäude, Mauern oder parkende Fahrzeuge den seitlich kommenden Verkehr verdecken.
de.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Gar nicht sicher — ich fühle mich auf solche Situationen nicht vorbereitet
de.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Etwas sicher — ich kenne die Risiken, werde aber oft überrascht
de.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Mäßig sicher — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen zurecht, manche machen mir aber noch Sorgen
de.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Ziemlich sicher — ich erkenne die meisten Gefahren früh und reagiere gut
de.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Sehr sicher — ich fühle mich auf die typischen Gefahren beim Radfahren gut vorbereitet

tr.#How confident are you in your ability t: Bisiklet sürerken tehlikeli durumları önceden fark edip tepki verme konusunda kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz? Örneğin aniden açılan otomobil kapıları, önünüzü kesen araçlar veya görüşü kısıtlı kavşaklar.
tr.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Görüşü kısıtlı kavşak, binaların, duvarların ya da park etmiş araçların yandan gelen trafiği gizlediği kavşaktır.
tr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Hiç güvende hissetmiyorum — bu durumlara hazırlıklı hissetmiyorum
tr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Biraz güvende hissediyorum — riskleri biliyorum ama sık sık hazırlıksız yakalanıyorum
tr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Orta düzeyde güvende hissediyorum — çoğu durumla başa çıkıyorum ama bazıları hâlâ beni endişelendiriyor
tr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Oldukça güvende hissediyorum — çoğu tehlikeyi önceden fark edip uygun şekilde tepki veriyorum
tr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Çok güvende hissediyorum — bisiklet kullanırken karşılaşılabilecek tipik tehlikelere iyi hazırlandığımı düşünüyorum

fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در پیش‌بینی و واکنش به موقعیت‌های خطرناک هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟ مثلاً باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو، پیچیدن خودرو جلوی شما یا تقاطع با دید محدود.
fa.#A junction with poor visibility is one: تقاطع با دید محدود تقاطعی است که در آن ساختمان‌ها، دیوارها یا خودروهای پارک‌شده ترافیکی را که از کنار می‌آید پنهان می‌کنند.
fa.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: اصلاً مطمئن نیستم — برای این موقعیت‌ها آماده نیستم
fa.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: کمی مطمئنم — خطرها را می‌شناسم اما اغلب غافلگیر می‌شوم
fa.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: تا حد متوسط مطمئنم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم، اما بعضی هنوز نگرانم می‌کنند
fa.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: نسبتاً مطمئنم — بیشتر خطرها را از قبل تشخیص می‌دهم و خوب واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: خیلی مطمئنم — برای خطرهای معمول دوچرخه‌سواری آمادگی خوبی دارم

hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire érzi magát magabiztosnak abban, hogy előre felismeri és kezeli a veszélyes helyzeteket kerékpározás közben, például hirtelen kinyíló autóajtót, elé forduló járművet vagy beláthatatlan kereszteződést?
hu.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Beláthatatlan kereszteződés az, ahol épületek, falak vagy parkoló járművek eltakarják az oldalról érkező forgalmat.
hu.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Egyáltalán nem vagyok magabiztos — nem érzem magam felkészültnek ezekre a helyzetekre
hu.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Kissé magabiztos vagyok — ismerem a kockázatokat, de gyakran váratlanul érnek
hu.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Közepesen magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb helyzetet kezelem, de néhány még aggaszt
hu.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Elég magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb veszélyt előre észreveszem és megfelelően reagálok
hu.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Nagyon magabiztos vagyok — jól felkészültnek érzem magam a kerékpározás tipikus veszélyeire

ar.#How confident are you in your ability t: ما مدى ثقتك في قدرتك على توقع المواقف الخطرة والتعامل معها أثناء ركوب الدراجة، مثل فتح باب سيارة فجأة أو قطع مركبة لطريقك أو تقاطع محدود الرؤية؟
ar.#A junction with poor visibility is one: التقاطع محدود الرؤية هو تقاطع تحجب فيه المباني أو الجدران أو المركبات المتوقفة حركة المرور القادمة من الجانب.
ar.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: لست واثقًا إطلاقًا — لا أشعر أنني مستعد لهذه المواقف
ar.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: واثق قليلًا — أعرف المخاطر لكنني أفاجأ بها كثيرًا
ar.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: واثق بدرجة متوسطة — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف لكن بعضها ما زال يقلقني
ar.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: واثق إلى حد كبير — أتوقع معظم المخاطر وأستجيب جيدًا
ar.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: واثق جدًا — أشعر أنني مستعد جيدًا للمخاطر المعتادة عند ركوب الدراجة
